site.name: Sonnet Every Day
site.tagline: One new, slightly ridiculous, surprisingly sophisticated thing on the web every morning.

days.title: Eleven Years of Overtime
days.tagline: A scrolling data essay about the sudden-death minutes that decide seasons.
days.description: Bundled game data, one long scroll, and a handful of annotated charts about how overtime actually ends.

days.title: The Unbuttoned Page
days.tagline: A web page that politely refuses to behave.
days.description: Every control on this page does something adjacent to what it says. A study in expectation, with a secret ending.

days.title: Headline Bingo, Satire Edition
days.tagline: A playful, clearly fictional bingo card for every news cycle.
days.description: Generates absurd, obviously invented headlines and lets you mark them off. Parody only, no real names, never partisan.

days.title: Pantry Chess
days.tagline: Plan a week of dinners from what is already in the cupboard.
days.description: Tell it what you have; it searches for a week of meals that uses it all before it expires, and explains each trade-off.

days.title: Ruin Odds
days.tagline: How long does a bankroll last? Simulate ten thousand lifetimes.
days.description: A risk-of-ruin visualizer for made-up money: pick a win rate and a bet size and watch the fan of possible futures.

days.title: How Compound Interest Lies
days.tagline: A calm explainer about why the last decade is worth more than the first three.
days.description: Interactive curves that show exactly where intuition fails: slide the rate, the time and the fees. Simulated money only.

days.title: Green Phosphor Terminal
days.tagline: A 1980s mainframe that only runs text adventures about its own uptime.
days.description: A faithful-feeling terminal emulator with a scanline shader, a fake filesystem and a game hidden in the man pages.

days.title: Gravel Rally
days.tagline: A one-thumb rally game with tire physics you can feel.
days.description: Top-down gravel racing with weight transfer, handbrake slides and five hand-drawn stages. Keyboard, touch and gamepad.

days.title: Receipt Roulette
days.tagline: Split any bill fairly, or dramatically.
days.description: Paste a receipt, pick a mood, and settle the tab with fair shares, weighted dice, or a tiny round of poker for the appetizers.

days.title: Postcard from the 21st
days.tagline: No build today. Here is a sky instead.
days.description: A stand-in edition: a generative postcard made from nothing but the date. Same date, same sky, every time.

days.title: Pun Foundry
days.tagline: Feed it a word, receive an unreasonable number of puns.
days.description: A phoneme-aware wordplay engine with a groan meter. Bundled pronunciation data, no network, many regrets.

days.title: Moire Garden
days.tagline: Two lattices, one slider, endless flowers.
days.description: A compact build: overlay rotating line gratings and harvest the interference patterns as wallpapers.

days.title: Basement Orchestra
days.tagline: Eleven synthetic instruments, one cursed room, zero rehearsal.
days.description: A pointer-driven ensemble: each instrument is a few lines of WebAudio, tuned by the room you draw around them.

days.title: Tangled Tangrams
days.tagline: Seven shapes, one silhouette, and a solver that sighs.
days.description: Drag, rotate and flip the classic seven pieces to fill daily silhouettes. A backtracking solver reveals one piece at a time if you ask nicely.

days.title: Ideas Day: Ten Pitches, No Build
days.tagline: Today the build slipped, so here are the ten ideas that almost were.
days.description: A stand-in edition. The shortlist for the day, with sources and scores, and a note on the idea that should have shipped.

days.title: Tidepool Clocks
days.tagline: A tiny ecosystem that keeps time by the moon.
days.description: Anemones, crabs and one smug starfish respond to a lunar tide table. Drag the moon to fast-forward a season and see who survives.

days.title: The Committee of Pigeons
days.tagline: Run a city council made entirely of pigeons. Motions pass by seed.
days.description: A bureaucratic farce with real procedure: agendas, points of order, and a bread subsidy that must be balanced against the park budget.

days.title: Thread Weather
days.tagline: The mood of a comment thread, drawn as a weather map.
days.description: Paste a thread, get a forecast: pressure fronts for arguments, sunshine for compliments, and a small hurricane for the word "actually".

days.title: Joker Fold
days.tagline: Design a scoring joker, watch the chain reaction, break the game politely.
days.description: A mod-concept editor for a deckbuilder: compose triggers and effects, then run 1,000 seeded hands to see whether your joker is a delight or a crime.

days.title: Glass Tempo
days.tagline: Shift-by-shift line changes, where fatigue is the real opponent.
days.description: A hockey bench simulator. Juggle three lines through a 60-minute game and watch tempo, fatigue and momentum trade places.

days.title: Pocket Rockets Range Atlas
days.tagline: A 13x13 preflop grid you can paint, then stress-test against a solver.
days.description: Paint opening ranges by position, then let a tiny equity engine tell you which hands you are overfolding. Ships with five bundled spots.
